def perform():
    total, limit = map(int, input().split())
    probabilities = list(map(float, input().split()))
    for i in range(total):
        if abs(probabilities[i]) < 1e-6:
            print("0 ", end='')
            continue
        subset_len = total - 1
        dp = [0.0] * (1 << subset_len)
        subset_probs = [probabilities[j] for j in range(total) if j != i]
        dp[0] = probabilities[i]
        total_sum = dp[0]
        for mask in range(1, 1 << subset_len):
            sumP = 0.0
            sumVal = 0.0
            count = 0
            for t in range(subset_len):
                if mask & (1 << t):
                    sumP += subset_probs[t]
                    sumVal += subset_probs[t] * dp[mask ^ (1 << t)]
                    count += 1
            dp[mask] = sumVal / (1 - sumP)
            if count < limit:
                total_sum += dp[mask]
        print(f"{total_sum} ", end='')
